integrity: The analytical argument covers all declared quantifiers. Standalone finite-state checks replay without third-party dependencies. Historical priority remains a non-certified literature comparison; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for finite homogeneous-rate paths, one SI source, a known age, and a perfectly observed infected prefix ending at the physical boundary. The full monotone-likelihood-ratio posterior comparison holds for any positive prior on the observed prefix. The complete MAP staircase requires a uniform prior. No conclusion for recovery, heterogeneous rates, uncertain age, partially observed infected sets, or general graphs.
title: An exact boundaryward posterior shift in finite-path epidemic source inference
